items.summary: Bournemouth are riding high on a seven-game winning streak across all competitions after their impressive 3-1 comeback victory over Sparta Prague in the Europa League, with Tyler Adams, Evanilson, and Rayan all finding the net off the bench.

source.title: Sparta Prague 1-3 Bournemouth: Super subs complete comeback win

items.summary: Marco Rose has confirmed that Junior Kroupi will get more minutes in the upcoming Premier League trip to Ipswich Town as the talented 20-year-old continues to build his fitness following a foot injury that kept him out at the start of the season.

source.title: Bournemouth boss Rose to continue cautious approach to Kroupi's injury return

items.summary: Both Evanilson and manager Marco Rose have been nominated for the Premier League Player and Manager of the Month awards for October, recognizing the Cherries remarkable turnaround with three consecutive league wins and clean sheets.

source.title: Premier League Reveal Player, Manager of the Month Nominees for October
